name: rock-boulder-low
description: Low broad 5m basalt boulder; bevelled planes and subtle strata.

name: rock-boulder-split
description: Split basalt boulder with a deep inclined cleft; two uneven halves.

name: rock-boulder-upright
description: Upright wind-worn pale boulder; angled cap, buttress and broad sediment bands.

name: rock-layered-outcrop
description: ~20m layered escarpment, staggered slabs and slanted exposed strata.

name: rock-spire-cluster
description: ~23m tall eroded basalt needles; three unequal spires and a shared rocky foot.

name: rock-natural-arch
description: ~22m natural stone arch with an open passage, asymmetric piers and a massive sloped lintel.

name: rock-scree-patch
description: Loose field of fifteen angular stones, varying size and orientation; no artificial slab underneath.

name: dead-tree-crooked
description: ~7m crooked leafless tree; exposed roots, leaning trunk and snapped asymmetric limbs.

name: dead-tree-forked
description: Tall forked dead tree; heavier charred base and two bleached, broken crowns.

name: dead-tree-fallen
description: Fallen trunk with pale broken end grain and three snapped branches; ~6m long.

name: dead-stump-hollow
description: Hollow broken stump with a dark heart, exposed pale rim, splinters and roots.

name: dead-scrub-spreading
description: Low spreading wind-flattened dead scrub, radial twisted twigs; no leaves.

name: dead-scrub-upright
description: Narrow upright dead thorn scrub, irregular twigs; no leaves.

name: dead-agave
description: Desiccated alien rosette: nine broad drooping blades and a brittle central spear; bone-grey, no green.

name: corridor-clean-floor
description: 4m square quiet deck: four broad plates, recessed cross seam, sparse amber edge markers. Walking surface Y=0.3m.

name: corridor-clean-wall
description: 4m x 3.2m double-sided wall; large flat panels, restrained base trim, one seam, no voxel speckle.

name: corridor-clean-window
description: 4m clean wall with a broad transparent observation pane and one mullion; matches the existing glass material.

name: corridor-clean-doorway
description: Open 2.8m-wide, 2.7m-high passage frame; broad surfaces, warm header light, access panel.

name: corridor-clean-straight
description: Open-top 4m straight module: smooth floor, two 3.2m walls, one observation window. Overall height 3.5m.

name: corridor-clean-corner
description: Open-top 4m corner module, openings on +X and -Y in the Z-up source; broad unbroken panels.

name: corridor-clean-junction
description: Open-top 4m T-junction: one glazed back wall, three matching full-width connections.

name: corridor-clean-ceiling
description: 4m removable ceiling tile; two recessed warm linear lights on underside, broad clean panels. Place at Y=3.5m over complete modules.
